title: Hoist the triplicated screenshot names[] list in tool/upload_store_assets.py to one constant
why: The same 5-element screenshot-name list is retyped verbatim inside the phone, 7-inch-tablet, and 10-inch-tablet upload loops. If a screenshot is ever added/renamed/reordered, all 3 copies must be updated in lockstep by hand; missing one silently mislabels an upload (the loop just indexes names[i-1] against whatever list is present) with no error since the script only checks os.path.exists implicitly via MediaFileUpload's own failure mode.
recommendation: Define `SCREENSHOT_NAMES = ["dashboard", "learning", "progress", "scheduler", "gamification"]` once at module scope (near PACKAGE_NAME/LANGUAGE) and reference it in all 3 loops.
acceptance_criteria: The literal list `["dashboard", "learning", "progress", "scheduler", "gamification"]` appears exactly once in the file.
